subject: a bell-bodied clockwork bird with short brass wings
art_direction: 小鸟身体是一枚无字青釉铃形壳，尾部短发条与金色翅片形成利落头像。
visible_description: 小鸟身体是一枚无字青釉铃形壳，尾部短发条与金色翅片形成利落头像。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a bell-bodied clockwork bird with short brass wings. Keep the small winding key tucked behind the body rather than protruding far outward. One dark eye and a short ivory beak define the face. Render enamel pooling around the wing joints and fine brass edges. The background is warm pale stone, with a single soft shadow under the compact silhouette. Use retro enamel automaton sculpture. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
